commitResults.messageTitle: Introduce Task class for task state management

commitResults.messageBody:
Replace parallel task data arrays with Task objects.
Encapsulate task descriptions and completion status in Task,
including mark-as-done and mark-as-not-done behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Encapsulate Task fields with private visibility
commitResults.messageBody:
Hide Task implementation details and preserve controlled access
through the class's public methods.

commitResults.messageTitle: Refactor task storage into TaskList class
Refactor command type detection into Parser
commitResults.messageBody:
Adds CommandType enum and centralizes command keyword detection in Parser,
reducing command-parsing logic in BingusDingus while preserving existing behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract user interface output into Ui class
commitResults.messageBody:
Moves user-facing messages and display logic from BingusDingus into a
dedicated Ui class, improving separation of responsibilities while
preserving existing behaviour
